scientific_question: In the single-channel blow-mold flow simulation, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the spatial nonuniformity of stored pressure. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Use the volume-weighted standard deviation divided by the absolute volume-weighted mean. Weight by the absolute signed cell volume from VTK and normalize by the included volume. Report the numerical coefficient.
